title: Separate the shared-row sum from the operator 2-norm (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The shared-row sum does not lift to `||B - C||_2 < 2 ε`.

- #4490 requires both inverses to lie within `ε` of one polynomial in the norm of the whole object. #4509 repeats that sentence at ceiling `9 p^2`.
- #4491 supplies `||P - H_sec^{-1}||_2 < ε` against each section's own polynomial, under that section's #4452 gauge. HALO makes the section polynomial match the global polynomial only on rows at distance `A = ceil(p^{48})`.
- The matrix with rows `(3, 0)` and `(0, 9)` has first-row squared length `9 < 8^2`, while `M e_2` has squared length `81 > 8^2`. A small row does not force the operator 2-norm below 8.
- The matrix with rows `(0, 0)` and `(0, 2)` shows that a zero row does not force `||P_B - P_C||_2 = 0`. The triangle then keeps an extra term, and `3 + 2 + 3 = 8` is not strictly below `2 · 4`.

This does not assert that the Gaussian section polynomials equal the displayed matrices. The locality audit's sharp row at distance `(2J - 1) W`, and its `2 p^{10} exp(-p^2)` inverse split, are different statements. Both ideal-gap gauges stay hypotheses. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`.

This answers the open question of #4512. A bound on `||P_sec - P_global||_2` off the rows at distance `A` is left open.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-operator-lift`
- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_OPERATOR_LIFT` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T03:07:14Z was that commit, and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T03:10:56Z was unchanged. κ remains `23/10000`.
